---
name: Feature request
about: Propose a new capability, format, operator, or reconstruction
title: "[FEATURE] "
labels: enhancement
---

**Problem**
What are you trying to do that UniMRI does not support today?

**Proposed solution**
What should the API look like? Which layer does this belong to (I/O, data model,
operator, reconstruction, pipeline)?

**Prior art**
Is this implemented elsewhere (mrpro, sigpy, BART, mri-nufft, …)? Could UniMRI
wrap it instead of reimplementing?

**Additional context**
References, papers, sample data.
